extracted.intended_audience: newspaper readers and editors interested in international affairs
extracted.subtask_description: A newspaper wire/feature article reporting diplomatic and political reactions to Germany's absorption of Czecho-Slovakia (breaking international news). The page includes both story copy and editorial insertion/deletion instructions for newsroom handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial deletion instruction (eliminate 15th paragraph)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction to editors to remove a specific paragraph from the story before publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text on page: "ELIMINATE 15TH GRAPH, STARTING AND CRAP, , BEGINING ‘THE RECALL oF waned >:" — an explicit directive telling editors to delete the 15th paragraph (starting with the indicated phrase).

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial insertion instruction (insert after fourth paragraph)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction that additional copy may be inserted after the fourth paragraph.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Text on page: "THE FOLLOWING MAY BE INSERTED AFTER FOURTH GRAPH, LOMDON, THIRD LEAD BRITISH XXX CENTRAL EUROPE." — an explicit editorial note providing optional copy to be inserted after paragraph four, followed by suggested insertion text and context for placement.
